test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 20 March, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'LANDS' is written as '10' and ‘TRAM’ is written as ‘13’. How will 'TASTE' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d16e50abe1a866069dc7ff61c99f97f83c1c43a73bc7da4d0c011f370fc1dfe.png] 

The logic followed here is :- Sum of the position value according to English alphabetic series is divided by the number of letters within the word.

​So,

 
• 'LANDS' is written as '10'

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/43fa0be8baace2dffbfab36252da054dddba84bf7228f4e0ce6e2762738afae0.png] 

And,

 
• ‘TRAM’ is written as ‘13’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/50c09c126b8b3f5aec92bfa864e6598ca82be6cfcfce681421ff27e8c19716c6.png] 

Similarly,

 
• 'TASTE' is written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a2c82b2b5e10dbbb0ce772cc7bd095397f8c496d2a34a25b3cb52593687310f.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "13".
